import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();logs=root/"logs/v0.1.3"
protected=[root/n for n in ["lean-toolchain","lakefile.toml","lake-manifest.json","ROADMAP_lean_PML_revised.md","scripts/run_logged.py"]]
protected+=list((root/"LeanPML").rglob("*.lean"))
protected+=[p for p in (root/"docs").rglob("*") if p.is_file()]
for stage in ["v0.0.3","v0.1.1","v0.1.2"]:
 protected+=[p for p in (root/"logs"/stage).rglob("*") if p.is_file()]
protected+=[Path.home()/".elan/settings.toml"]
for project in [Path("/Users/wcli/Desktop/资料/graduate_student/博/Lean_study/ScalarDissipation"),root.parent/"lean_verification"]:
 protected+=[project/n for n in ["lean-toolchain","lakefile.toml","lake-manifest.json"] if (project/n).is_file()]
hashes={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in protected}
(logs/"input_hashes.json").write_text(json.dumps(hashes,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
for n in ["README.md","PROGRESS.md","LeanPML.lean","Audit.lean"]:
 (logs/("before_"+n)).write_bytes((root/n).read_bytes())
print("受保护文件:",len(hashes))
print("适用AGENTS: 无（已检查祖先及LeanPML/docs/scripts目录）")
print("路线图 SHA256:",hashes[str(root/"ROADMAP_lean_PML_revised.md")])
print("已保存四份修改前快照。")
